text: ぜんしんが　きんにくに　なっており　こどもほどの　おおきさしかないのに　おとな　１００にんを　なげとばせる。

structure.jp: ぜんしんが　きんにくに　なっており
structure.en: its whole body is muscle, and

structure.jp: こどもほどの　おおきさしかないのに
structure.en: although it is only about the size of a child

structure.jp: おとな　１００にんを　なげとばせる。

patterns.name: 〜しか〜ない
patterns.explanation: しか together with ない means 'only', 'nothing more than'. こどもほどの　おおきさしかない = 'it is only about as big as a child'.

patterns.name: 〜のに
patterns.explanation: のに means 'even though', for a result you would not expect. おおきさしかないのに = 'even though it is only that size'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ており is a written form of ていて: a state that holds, joined to what follows with 'and'. きんにくに　なっており = 'has become muscle, and'.
